mainEntity.name: How do I know if a marble tile installer is qualified?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should ask for recent project photos, a written scope, and confirmation that the installer has experience with natural stone. Marble is less forgiving than ceramic or porcelain, so a contractor who handles stone regularly is more likely to avoid chips, uneven joints, and premature staining.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for proof of natural-stone experience, written estimates, and examples of finished marble work. Marble needs skilled handling, so general tile experience alone is not always enough.
